messages:
Ava: Heads up — since ~02:24 UTC we've got a cluster-side regression: GPUs showing available but pods pending. Metric spike at 02:20 in us-west2. Anyone seeing similar?

matt: Yep. Nodes report allocatable GPUs but scheduler rejects bindings. Logs show 'lease mismatch: ring token expired' repeatedly.

leah: I saw kubelet restart flaps on a subset of nodes earlier. My hunch: kubelet move changed topology k/v so reservations persisted but node identity drifted.

jordan: Quick checks: `kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{@.metadata.name}: {.status.allocatable."nvidia.com/gpu"}{"\n"}{end}'` returns positive counts, but describing nodes shows taint `gpu-sticky=true:NoSchedule` and annotation `scheduler.alpha.kubernetes.io/gpu-alloc: ring-abc123`. Events include FailedAttachVolume timeouts.

matt: The autoscaler trimmed warm nodes at 02:35 (low utilization). That likely removed nodes still holding PVC/attach/cached leases — leaving orphaned reservation annotations.

ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled down nodepool-usw2-gpu by 3 at 02:35 — reason: low utilization.

leah: Workaround: remove taint and stale allocation annotation, then run descheduler for pods with `reservation=shadow`. Script I used: 

```
kubectl get nodes -l problematic=true -o name | xargs -n1 -I{} kubectl annotate {} scheduler.alpha.kubernetes.io/gpu-alloc- 
kubectl taint nodes -l problematic=true gpu-sticky=true:NoSchedule- 
```

matt: After clearing annotations two nodes started accepting pods within a minute. Still ~9 pods pending across other nodes. I'll roll kubelet restarts on the remaining nodes to force lease cleanup.

jordan: I'll open a ticket to add a descheduler rule for expired GPU leases and a guard in autoscaler to check active GPU leases before scaling down warm nodes.

Ava: Please create an incident and add a short blameless note to incidents channel; link dashboards.

jordan: INFRA-1427 created with logs and grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc/gpu-scheduler?panelId=7

ops-bot: incident created: #INC-2026-03-21-gpu-reservation-shadow
